verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents a dedicated annual report service: it prepares and files a personalized annual report to meet state requirements (legalzoom-docs-11), offers auto-filing of annual reports as an ongoing service (legalzoom-docs-13), and adds expedited filing (legalzoom-docs-12) and free correction of filings rejected due to its own error (legalzoom-docs-23). This is a clear managed service. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the annual-report filing service, and an explanation of the † caveat on auto-filing (state coverage or eligibility limits).
